trends.name: Iran Conflict & Oil Price Volatility
trends.summary: Trump's Tuesday deadline for Iran infrastructure strikes faces 5th delay as negotiations stall. Negotiators 'pessimistic' on Strait of Hormuz reopening, creating massive geopolitical risk and headline-driven oil price swings. Market pricing in escalation scenario with potential for significant energy cost shocks.

trends.name: AI Chip & Infrastructure Boom
trends.summary: Samsung sees 8-fold profit jump on AI chip demand; Broadcom lands expanded deals with Google and Anthropic. BE Semiconductor positioned as AI packaging bottleneck play. Broader AI infrastructure investment thesis driving semiconductor and equipment valuations.

trends.name: Shopify AI-Driven Commerce Pivot
trends.summary: Shopify receives double rating upgrade on AI-driven commerce transformation thesis, not valuation. Next growth leg centered on AI enablement for merchants. Signals major shift in how commerce platforms create competitive advantage.

trends.name: Retail Selling Pressure & Consumer Sentiment
trends.summary: Retail investors dumping stocks at alarming pace with pattern of 'skipping dips, selling rallies.' Tax refund inflow ($222B) larger than prior year but insufficient to offset selling pressure. Rising housing unaffordability (only 12% married with homes by 30 vs 52% in 1960) dampening consumer confidence.

trends.name: Interest Rates as Market Bottom Signal
trends.summary: Jim Cramer argues stock market bottom depends on interest rate trajectory, not war headlines. Inflation swap rates at 3.24% on 1yr showing inflation expectations remain elevated. Fed policy path becoming critical pivot point for equity recovery.

trends.name: Retail Sector Price Competition Headwinds
trends.summary: TJX Companies and broader retail facing margin pressure as competitors shift to price competition. The Buckle downgraded despite strong fundamentals due to macro headwinds. Consumer sensitivity to pricing amid cost-of-living concerns reshaping retail economics.

trends.name: AI Security as Emerging Cybersecurity Theme
trends.summary: 'AI Security' emerging as next major cybersecurity investment theme beyond traditional endpoint and network protection. Companies leveraging AI for threat detection and response becoming priority. Sector rotation play as enterprises prioritize AI-enhanced defense capabilities.

trends.name: Oracle Layoffs & AI Efficiency Gains
trends.summary: Oracle's layoff announcements seen as fulfilling AI productivity promises in analyst view, with 'buy the dip' recommendation. Demonstrates how AI adoption translating to real workforce reduction and margin expansion. Template for enterprise AI ROI realization.

trends.name: Healthcare Policy Boost to Insurers
trends.summary: Trump administration finalizes Medicare Advantage payment rates better than feared, providing significant boost to health insurers. Policy support creating tailwind for managed care valuations in near term. Shift from industry fears of cuts to actual rate improvements.

trends.name: Foldable iPhone Supply Chain Delays
trends.summary: Apple's foldable iPhone hitting engineering snags with possible shipment delays per Nikkei. Supply chain risk for major 2026 product launch. Consumer electronics sector facing manufacturing complexity headwinds.

trends.name: Anthropic Private Equity Capital Raise
trends.summary: Anthropic in talks to invest $200M in new private-equity venture, signaling expansion beyond core AI model business. Capital deployment strategy reshaping AI startup economics. Broader trend of AI companies diversifying revenue beyond model licensing.

trends.name: Japan Nikkei Bearish Technical Breakdown
trends.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 flashing bearish breakdown below 50-day moving average amid U.S.-Iran tensions and yen weakness. Asian market vulnerability to geopolitical escalation. Technical deterioration creating headwinds for global risk sentiment.
